title: Mechanical Door Repairers
description: Install, service, or repair automatic door mechanisms and hydraulic doors. Includes garage door mechanics.

tasks.text: Wind large springs with upward motion of arm.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Complete required paperwork, such as work orders, according to services performed or required.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document routine operational activities from inputs

dwas.name: Document operational activities.

tasks.text: Repair or replace worn or broken door parts, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Fasten angle iron back-hangers to ceilings and tracks, using fasteners or welding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mechanical assembly needs hands and tools

dwas.name: Assemble mechanical components or machine parts.

tasks.text: Order replacement springs, sections, or slats.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Carry springs to tops of doors, using ladders or scaffolding, and attach springs to tracks to install spring systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of materials and supplies

dwas.name: Move materials, equipment, or supplies.

tasks.text: Install door frames, rails, steel rolling curtains, electronic-eye mechanisms, or electric door openers and closers, using power tools, hand tools, and electronic test equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing interior fixtures is hands-on

dwas.name: Install hardware or other interior fixtures.

tasks.text: Adjust doors to open or close with the correct amount of effort, or make simple adjustments to electric openers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Set doors into place or stack hardware sections into openings after rail or track installation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual tool and equipment positioning in field

dwas.name: Position equipment using hand tools, power tools, or heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Assemble and fasten tracks to structures or bucks, using impact wrenches or welding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Assembling structural components is hands-on

dwas.name: Assemble structural components.

tasks.text: Inspect job sites, assessing headroom, side room, or other conditions to determine appropriateness of door for a given location.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Work conditions require physical site assessment

dwas.name: Gather information about work conditions or locations.

tasks.text: Collect payment upon job completion.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — In-person payment handling; some digital automation

dwas.name: Collect payments for goods or services.

tasks.text: Prepare doors for hardware installation, such as drilling holes to install locks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Cut door stops or angle irons to fit openings.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cutting to specifications

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.text: Remove or disassemble defective automatic mechanical door closers, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.
Remove parts or components from equipment.

tasks.text: Run low voltage wiring on ceiling surfaces, using insulated staples.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Running wiring is hands-on installation

dwas.name: Run wiring to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Operate lifts, winches, or chain falls to move heavy curtain doors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating heavy equipment by hand in field

dwas.name: Move large objects using heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Install dock seals, bumpers, or shelters.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Heavy structural foundation work needs hands-on construction

dwas.name: Install structural foundations.

tasks.text: Study blueprints and schematic diagrams to determine appropriate methods of installing or repairing automated door openers.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Diagram interpretation partial, human confirms installation

dwas.name: Interpret blueprints, specifications, or diagrams to inform installation, development or operation activities.

tasks.text: Lubricate door closer oil chambers, and pack spindles with leather washers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Bore or cut holes in flooring as required for installation, using hand or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling parts requires physical tool operation

dwas.name: Drill holes in parts, equipment, or materials.

tasks.text: Clean door closer parts, using caustic soda, rotary brushes, or grinding wheels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Set in and secure floor treadles for door-activating mechanisms, and connect power packs and electrical panelboards to treadles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Assemble electrical components, subsystems, or systems.
Connect electrical components or equipment.

tasks.text: Fabricate replacements for worn or broken parts, using welders, lathes, drill presses, or shaping or milling machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.

tasks.text: Cover treadles with carpeting or other floor covering materials, and test systems by operating treadles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.
